classification.editionNote: Twelve divisions as published in the pinned 2024 document; not automatically COICOP 2018 and not a production classification.
classification.nameTranscription: Source names with line breaks joined; spelling retained. Phase 11 category labels are shorter display paraphrases.

catalog.name: Pijet alkoolike, duhani
catalog.unmappedReason: Agricultural inputs, processing and excise/retail components cannot be separated with current model data.

catalog.name: Strehimi , uji, energji elektrike, gazi dhe lëndë djegëse të tjera
catalog.unmappedReason: Housing services and household fuels are not an industry basket; production energy is already an input, not household energy consumption.

catalog.name: Mobilje, pajisje shtëpie dhe mirëmbajtje e shtëpisë
Shëndetësia
catalog.unmappedReason: Medicines/equipment and health services are mixed; government health budgets are not household consumption.

catalog.name: Transporti
catalog.unmappedReason: Vehicles, fuel and passenger services are mixed; trade shippingPct is not household transport expenditure.

catalog.name: Mjetet e komunikimit
catalog.unmappedReason: Equipment and telecom services have no separate household demand in the model.

catalog.name: Rekracioni dhe kultura
catalog.unmappedReason: Mixed consumer goods and services lack a product-to-purpose bridge.

catalog.name: Arsimi
catalog.unmappedReason: Household education services are not state education spending or an industry goods quantity.

catalog.name: Restorantet dhe hotelet
catalog.unmappedReason: Prepared meals and accommodation services cannot be assigned to agricultural output.

catalog.name: Mallrat dhe shërbimet e ndryshme
catalog.unmappedReason: Personal goods, insurance, finance and other services have no measured split between the two model categories.

modelCategories.name: Mallra bujqësore
modelCategories.description: Aggregate agricultural output and goods balance; not a food expenditure classification.
modelCategories.missingData: Product-level consumption quantities, processing/import margins and product-to-COICOP correspondence.

modelCategories.name: Mallra industriale
modelCategories.description: Aggregate industrial output and goods balance; contains no defined household product composition.
modelCategories.missingData: Consumer-product composition, services split, household expenditure shares and product-to-purpose correspondence.

links.rationale: Food can contain agricultural products, but processed foods, beverages, imported content and trade margins are not identified. The full division cannot be equated to agricultural production.
links.overlapRisk: Code 01 also has a possible industrial processing component; no weight is allocated to either category.
links.needs: A product/processing/retail bridge and historical category series beyond the one snapshot.

links.rationale: Food processing may be industrial; the model does not identify its share. This is an alternative partial link, not an allocation in addition to agriculture.
links.overlapRisk: Shared candidate code 01; adding both would double count unmeasured processing and primary output.
links.needs: Measured separation of primary output, processing and final-consumption value.

links.rationale: Clothing and footwear include manufactured consumer goods, but there is no evidence of their share in the aggregate industrial index or of imported/retail value.
links.overlapRisk: A consumer-purpose index is not an industrial-output price; do not use the entire division as the industrial category.
links.needs: Product composition and a consistent time series with prices at the relevant valuation basis.

links.rationale: Furniture and household equipment may be manufactured goods; maintenance and other services are mixed and not separated.
links.overlapRisk: Goods, installation/maintenance services and margins cannot be assigned one-for-one to production.
links.needs: Goods/services decomposition and measured final-consumption shares.

aggregation.reason: No defensible quantitative bridge from expenditure purposes to the two production/goods aggregates. Published HICP index weights are not automatically household spending shares at the model activation date.
aggregation.exclusionMeaning: Excluded codes are not included in proposed candidate links, not a claim that those goods or services are absent from the economy. All quantitative empirical aggregation remains blocked, including candidate codes.
